title: A spatial structure regulation strategy modulated the solubility and compactness of novel face-on oriented bisphosphonate-anchored SAMs for efficient inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02269J, Paper
Weixu Duan, Kai Chen, Bingxue Pi, Shaojian Li, Zedong Lin, Cong Liu, Yuehua Pan, Haiqian Ling, Desheng Li, Liwei Zhou, Tao Liu, Fan Wu, Xiangwen Guo, Bingsuo Zou, Xiaotian Hu
A spatial structure regulation strategy was used to achieve a remarkable PCE of 25.81%, which represents the highest efficiency for PSCs using novel face-on oriented bisphosphonate-anchored self-assembled molecules as HTLs.
